name: 14905-batchdecode-opt125m-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one GPU, one engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 40000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, fixed shape -- exactly 64 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens per request (min=max on both), `ignore_eos` on, `request_format: plain`.
purpose: A compact assistant generating fixed 256-token replies to short prompts for 1024 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 8a5a9b70d702feb17e79691870c638b0f1e71192 -- `git describe --tags --match 'v*'`
# gives v0.7.3-493-g8a5a9b70d702. That is a COMMIT, NOT A RELEASE: do not read "0.7.3" as
# "run v0.7.3". This is a 0.7.3-era V1 engine and an unknown key is a TypeError at engine
# construction, so do not add arguments taken from a later vLLM.

model: facebook/opt-125m

# `auto` resolves to this checkpoint's own config.json torch_dtype; written out so it cannot drift.
dtype: float16

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned: the operating point is that the engine admits all 1024 offered streams at once.
max-num-seqs: 1024

# Pinned because the default does not survive this entry point -- it is filled from a
# per-usage-context table with no row for the async engine, so an unpinned run falls back to a
# 2048-token budget and admission is throttled by accident. 8192 is the engine's own H100 value.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Engine defaults, written out so a change of default cannot move the operating point.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true

# The one line here that is not a default: nothing reads the iteration-statistics log.
disable-log-stats: true
